Hi, I'm Steven. I'm a data and analytics professional currently based in Raleigh as I complete my Master's in Analytics, with plans to relocate to the Boston area after graduation.

I specialize in transforming complex data into actionable strategy. Currently an MS candidate at the Institute for Advanced Analytics, I build analytical models and solutions using Python, R, and SQL.

My approach is grounded by a background in intelligence analysis and psychology, helping me bridge the gap between rigorous statistical modeling and real-world decision-making. I am passionate about solving tough problems and communicating tangible impact to audiences.
